# Blue Shadows Barber Studio

> Blue Shadows Barber Studio is a premium barbershop in Milton, Ontario, offering precision haircuts, fades, beard trims, lineups, hair colour, and hot towel grooming for men, students, seniors, and kids.

Blue Shadows serves Milton, Georgetown, Halton Hills, and the surrounding Halton Region. New clients receive 10% off their first haircut appointment. Appointments can be booked online or by phone.
